name: v1.0.0
body:
## Epson reset

- Finds a printer over USB or over the network via SNMP, and identifies it against 1588 models
- Decodes the waste ink pad counters, and resets them

## Before you use it

Resetting the counter does not empty the pad, a pad at the end of its life still needs replacing.
**This is your decision and your risk**, with no warranty. Stay in dry run if that isn't a trade you
want to make; it writes nothing.

[Troubleshooting](https://github.com/yusnel-rojas/epson-reset/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md) ·
